title: Around the World
tagline: Global general knowledge. Faster answers score more.

questions.question: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.fact: Canberra was built as a compromise between rivals Sydney and Melbourne.

questions.question: Which river runs through the middle of Paris?
What is the tallest mountain in the world above sea level?
Which country gave the Statue of Liberty to the United States?
questions.fact: The statue was dedicated in New York Harbor in 1886.

questions.question: What is the smallest country in the world by area?
questions.fact: Vatican City covers only about 109 acres.

questions.question: What is the longest river in South America?
questions.fact: The Amazon carries more water than any other river on Earth.

questions.question: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.fact: The Pacific is bigger than all of Earth's land put together.

questions.question: What is the currency of Japan?
Machu Picchu is in which country?
questions.fact: The Inca built Machu Picchu in the 1400s.

questions.question: Mount Kilimanjaro is in which country?
questions.fact: Kilimanjaro is the tallest mountain in Africa.

questions.question: Which is the largest country in the world by area?
The Taj Mahal is in which Indian city?
questions.fact: Emperor Shah Jahan built it in memory of his wife, Mumtaz Mahal.

questions.question: What is the largest hot desert in the world?
questions.fact: The Sahara is roughly the size of the United States.

questions.question: What is the capital of Canada?
The crosswalk on the cover of the Beatles' Abbey Road is in which city?
questions.fact: Abbey Road came out in 1969. The crosswalk is still there.
